test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements related to the Namo Drone Didi scheme launched during 2024 are correct?

(I) It is a central sector scheme aimed at empowering women-led SHGs through drone-based agricultural services.

(II) The scheme is primarily implemented by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.

(III) The scheme aims to enhance the income of women SHGs by providing drones for use in agriculture.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3: Only 1 and 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Namo Drone Didi scheme is aimed at empowering women-led self-help groups (SHGs) by enabling them to offer drone-based agricultural services.
 
• It is a central sector scheme launched in 2024 to improve the livelihoods of women SHGs by integrating advanced technology such as drones into agricultural practices.
 
• The scheme focuses on enhancing the income of women SHGs by providing drones for agricultural purposes like pesticide spraying and crop monitoring.
 
• The primary objective is to bridge the gap in technology adoption in rural areas while simultaneously promoting gender empowerment through skill development.
 
• The scheme aligns with the government’s broader vision of digital transformation in agriculture and fostering women entrepreneurship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Drones in Agriculture:**

 
 
• Drones are increasingly being used for precision agriculture, including crop monitoring, soil analysis, irrigation planning, and pesticide application.
 
• They help reduce the cost of manual labor and improve the efficiency and accuracy of farming practices.
 
 
 
• **Central Sector Scheme:**
 
 
• Central sector schemes are fully funded by the central government and implemented by its agencies.
 
• These schemes often target specific areas like agriculture, education, or skill development.
 
 
 
• **Self-Help Groups (SHGs):**
 
 
• SHGs are community-based organizations primarily consisting of women, aiming to provide financial and social support to their members.
 
• They play a significant role in rural development and poverty alleviation through micro-financing and skill-building initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Digital Agriculture Initiatives in India:**
 
 
• The government has been promoting the use of technology in agriculture through programs like the Digital Agriculture Mission 2021-2025.
 
• These initiatives focus on integrating AI, IoT, and drone technology to enhance agricultural productivity.
 
 
 
• **Women Empowerment through Technology:**
 
 
• Technology-based schemes like Namo Drone Didi aim to provide skill development, financial independence, and entrepreneurial opportunities for women.
 
• Such initiatives contribute to achieving gender equality and sustainable development goals (SDGs).
